findings.desc: Host-B (codex, round 3, red-green lens) verified: when one of the ten registered names is removed from the compiled registry, scope-contract-smoke fails at the aggregate assert.equal(proofStoryPositive.status, 'pass') BEFORE the per-row loop runs, so the failure diagnostic does not name which artifact row regressed. The smoke bites (fail is real) but the diagnostic is aggregate-only. Fix: run the per-row assertScopeRow loop (whose message names the file) before the overall-status assertion, keeping both checks (overall pass still guards warn-masking per CHK-002:adversarial:2).
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in ff86e56426: per-row assertScopeRow loop now runs before the aggregate status assertion in scope-contract-smoke.ts. Verified by bite test: removing 'proofstory.json' from the compiled registry makes the smoke fail with 'B-12a1 ProofStory lifecycle row proofstory.json: expected scope row not found' (names the exact artifact); restoring the dist returns the smoke to pass. Both checks retained — the overall-status assertion still guards warn-masking per CHK-002:adversarial:2.
